name: Aphids
description: Small sap-sucking insects that attack a wide range of crops. They cause direct damage through feeding and indirect damage by transmitting plant viruses.
symptoms: Sticky honeydew on leaves promoting sooty mold growth
Colonies of small soft-bodied insects on leaf undersides
Ants attending aphid colonies for honeydew
treatments: Spray insecticidal soap or neem oil at first sighting
Apply systemic insecticides (imidacloprid) for heavy infestations
Use strong water spray to dislodge aphid colonies
Introduce natural predators like ladybugs and lacewings
prevention: Monitor crops regularly, especially during dry weather
Use reflective mulches to repel aphids
Plant trap crops like mustard or sunflower
Conserve beneficial insects through reduced pesticide use
